title: Secant and Tangent Lengths Assessment
description: Show mastery of solving length problems using secant-secant and tangent-secant power relationships.

questions.question: Which relationship applies when two secants are drawn from the same external point?
questions.explanation: The secant-secant relationship multiplies each external segment by its whole secant.

questions.question: Two secants start at point P. One has outside length 4 and inside length 20. The other has outside length 8 and inside length x. Find x.
A tangent has length 18. A secant from the same point has outside length 9 and inside length x. Find x.
Two secants from point A have outside/inside lengths 2 and 22, and x and 6. Which equation can be used to solve for x?
questions.explanation: The first whole secant is 24. The second whole secant is x + 6, so the equation is 2(24) = x(x + 6).

questions.question: A tangent has length 20. A secant from the same point has outside length 16 and inside length x. Fill in x.
For a secant with outside length 7 and inside length 11, the whole secant length is 18.
questions.explanation: The whole secant includes both parts: 7 + 11 = 18.

questions.question: Two secants from the same external point have outside/inside lengths 3 and 13, and 6 and x. Find x.
A learner sees a tangent length of 15 and a secant with outside length 5 and inside length x. Which equation is correct?
questions.explanation: Use tangent-secant: the tangent is squared and the secant side is external times whole secant.

questions.question: Two secants from point B have outside/inside lengths 8 and 7, and 10 and x. Fill in x.
Set up and solve: a tangent from point P is 14 units. A secant from P has outside length 7 and inside length x. Find x.
questions.explanation: The tangent-secant relationship gives 14^2 = 7(7 + x), and solving gives x = 21.

questions.question: A student writes 6(10) = 5x for two secants with outside/inside lengths 6 and 4, and 5 and x. Explain the mistake and give the correct equation.
questions.correctAnswer: The student used only the inside part x instead of the whole second secant. The correct equation is 6(6 + 4) = 5(5 + x), or 6(10) = 5(5 + x).
questions.explanation: Each side must be external segment times whole secant, not external segment times inside segment.

questions.question: Two secants from point C have outside/inside lengths x and 5, and 4 and 11. Which positive value of x works?
questions.explanation: Set x(x + 5) = 4(15) = 60. Then x^2 + 5x - 60 = 0, so (x + 12)(x - 5) = 0. The positive length is x = 5.
